title: Selection and clipboard
hints: Add two fields: `selection: tuple[int, int] | None` and `clipboard: str | None`. `None` cleanly means "no selection" and "nothing copied yet" — don't use `""` or `(0, 0)` as sentinels.
Normalize in `select`: clamp both ends, then `start, end = sorted((start, end))`. Store the tuple only if `start < end`, and set the cursor to `end` either way.

Every edit now targets a range: the selection if there is one, otherwise the empty range at the cursor: `start, end = self.selection or (self.cursor, self.cursor)`. Feed that into your `_splice` helper and `insert` handles both cases.
Clear the selection in exactly one place — inside `_splice` — plus `move_cursor`. Then `paste` is `if self.clipboard is None: return False`, otherwise `self.insert(self.clipboard)`.
